WHO WE ARE

The strength
behind the skyline.

Manoeuvre Infra is the execution arm of G.R. & Sons Developers and Promoters. Our portfolio spans homes, apartments and commercial complexes.

We bring modern machinery and a steady focus on quality, safety and timely handover to projects of different scales. Our scope runs from foundation work and RCC structures through to finishing, electrical and plumbing.
